title: 仓颉字迹肖像示意
source: AI illustration generated for this project using the built-in image generation tool; a modern artistic interpretation of the legendary Cangjie, not a historical likeness.
prompt: Front-facing head-and-shoulders ink-wash portrait of Cangjie, the legendary inventor of Chinese writing; traditional four-eyed sage, broad forehead, long beard, simple ancient robe, white background, clear facial planes, no text, seals or frames; vertical 3:4 composition.
composition: Rendered with the site's PortraitRender259 at density 30. Example glyphs use the existing LXGW WenKai font (fonts/annotation-hand.woff2, SIL Open Font License); they are not user handwriting and are never added to the handwriting ledger.
